# Hikity

> Accessible Digital Infrastructure, Managed E-Commerce, Office Automation & Web Engineering in India.

Hikity (by HIKAT) is an Indian digital technology and software engineering firm. Hikity builds managed e-commerce platforms, office workflow automation, and custom web applications for businesses across India, including Tier-1, Tier-2, and Tier-3 cities like Bhagalpur, Bihar.

## Core Offerings

- [Hikity Commerce Platform](https://hikity.xyz/commerce): Complete managed e-commerce storefronts starting from ₹30,000/year. Includes mobile camera catalog uploads, UPI QR payments, gross & net profit tracking, customer account management, and instant WhatsApp product sharing.
- [Services Hub](https://hikity.xyz/services): Specialized digital solutions across healthcare, education, hospitality, crafts, personal portfolios, and enterprise automation.
- [Bhagalpur Case Studies](https://hikity.xyz/case-studies): Real-world business transformations:
  - **Anita Gift House (Bhagalpur)**: Retail gift store shifted from 14-hour daily manual WhatsApp photo-sending and status updates to an automated online store with live inventory and real-time profit tracking.
  - **KLATAX (Bhagalpur)**: Office platform for tax advisory firm, automating client appointments, secure tax document uploads, and automated SMS/WhatsApp status tracking.
- [Women Entrepreneur Initiative](https://hikity.xyz/women): Turnkey digital storefront packages empowering women business owners to build nationwide brands with low upfront financial barriers.
- [Enterprise Systems](https://hikity.xyz/business): High-performance web applications, custom CRM integrations, and AI agent automation.
- [Hikity Build Program](https://hikity.xyz/build): Equity or capital co-founding technical partnership acting as fractional CTO for high-growth startups.

## Technology Stack

- Cloud Hosting: Vercel Cloud
- Database & Auth: Supabase Real-Time Engine
- Asset CDN: Cloudinary Global Image CDN
- Frontend Framework: React, Vite, Glassmorphic UI Architecture
- Contact Email: contact@hikity.xyz
